class.name: hkpConvexVerticesShape
class.manual: Fitted to DS1 bytes (o2770 o2770_1.hkx; no DS1 file describes it). DS3's members, but hk_2010.2 has 4 more bytes after useSpuBuffer (always zero, unnamed), so planeEquations is at 88 and connectivity at 100. Checks: rotatedVertices count = ceil(numVertices / 4) (12 for 45, 10 for 39); the connectivity pointer is the global fixup at +100; its face count equals the plane count (68) or the planes add 6 bevel planes (66 vs 56).
